title: Setup: a side-to-move field that is neither w nor b is a position of no board
rationale: The placement is a legal setup and the second field is not a side: the frozen encoding spells Red as w and Black as b, and W is neither. A reading that took the first letter and called everything else Black would accept this position and judge it for the wrong mover, which is the one thing a side-to-move field decides. The predicate reads its own structure, so the whole field is the field.
